proof: A cap violation at this state requires K=637 distinct raw clauses because K<=636 implies 1+636+Wmax_6(636)=3361<3364.

Only c=28 retained clauses exist, while p*q=21*29=609. Therefore K=637 requires every one of the 609 cross-parent pairs to produce a distinct non-tautological new resolvent, with no pair lost to tautology/duplication/collision.

Hence every P row and every Q column is clean. The >=609 distinct new signed clauses must contain both signs of every nonpivot coordinate, since forbidding one sign on one coordinate leaves at most 2*3^5=486 signed vectors.

A coordinate cannot occur in both the P and Q clean cores. If a P tail and a Q tail both contain it, their non-tautological pair fixes a common sign s; row/column cleanliness then forbids the opposite sign in every parent and hence every new resolvent, contradicting the previous step.
Thus the active supports of all 21 P tails and all 29 Q tails are disjoint subsets of the six nonpivot coordinates.

Twenty-one distinct nonempty ternary tails require at least three active coordinates because 3^2-1=8<21. Twenty-nine distinct nonempty ternary tails require at least four active coordinates because 3^3-1=26<29.
Disjoint supports would therefore require at least 3+4=7 coordinates, but only six exist. Contradiction.
So at least one of the 609 cross pairs cannot contribute a distinct non-tautological new resolvent. Hence J<=608, K<=28+608=636, and the canonical raw storage is at most 1+636+Wmax_6(636)=3361<3364.
